name: XStation 2
tagLine: All-in-one multi-biometric access terminal with a 5" touchscreen and Android platform.
summary:
The XStation 2 is Suprema's flagship multi-biometric access control terminal, combining fingerprint recognition, RFID card reading and mobile credential support in a single, sleek device. Built on an Android platform with a vibrant 5-inch touchscreen, it offers a customisable user interface and supports a wide range of third-party applications via the BioStar 2 platform.

Designed for enterprise environments across South Africa, the XStation 2 delivers fast, reliable authentication at lobbies, server rooms, office floors and secure perimeter entry points — with IP65 and IK08 ratings ensuring durability in demanding conditions.

features.title: Multi-biometric authentication
features.description: Fingerprint, face (optional), RFID card, PIN and mobile credential — mix and match to suit your security policy.

features.title: Android-based open platform
features.description: Run custom apps directly on the device. Integrates with BioStar 2 and third-party access management systems.

features.title: 5-inch HD touchscreen
features.description: Crisp, responsive display for user-friendly operation and on-screen visitor guidance.

features.title: IP65 & IK08 rated
features.description: Dust-tight, water-resistant and impact-rated for indoor and semi-outdoor deployments.
